title: Kushiel's Dart
author: Jacqueline Carey
summary: In an alternate Renaissance Europe, a girl sold into service is trained as a courtesan-spy, marked from birth with a mark that ties her to a painful kind of pleasure. She uncovers a plot that threatens her country and has to travel far to stop it.
readIf: you want a very long, lush, political fantasy with sensual detail and a narrator with a distinctive voice.
skipIf: you are uncomfortable with explicit sexual content, including BDSM, or with sexual coercion and torture on the page.

pairings.reason: Another richly written, politically minded epic that is more sorrowful and has an Italianate setting.
A more mainstream, quicker romantasy that shares the heat and court intrigue.
Another vast, standalone epic with court politics, queer love and a large cast.
